explanation: Encodes 6n - c₁n^{2/3} ≤ f_3(n) ≤ 6n - c₂n^{2/3} for large n, with c₂ > 0. Leaving c₁ unconstrained in sign is harmless, since only large c₁ is needed. The upper bound is established by Bezdek–Reid (f_3(n) < 6n - 0.926n^{2/3}) and the lower bound by close-packed ball clusters, so the solved status is reasonable.
